title: Epoch AI: inference price trends
method: Independent analysis of model prices at fixed benchmark performance.
limitations: Historical rates vary by benchmark and period. Token prices exclude integration, review and the cost of an accepted business outcome.

title: Noy & Zhang: productivity effects of generative AI
method: Randomized experiment; 453 professionals on writing tasks.
limitations: Short assigned work products and evaluator scores, not whole-job productivity or firm profit. Published abstract and institutional summary reviewed.

title: METR: early-2025 developer productivity experiment
limitations: Experienced contributors working in familiar mature projects. A narrow historical result, not a current estimate for all developers.

title: METR: changes to developer experiment design
limitations: Later observations suffered selection and measurement problems. The researchers do not provide a dependable universal current speedup estimate.

title: Chegg: 2025 full-year results
method: Company financial results and management commentary.
limitations: Financial decline is observed; the contribution of AI substitution versus distribution and other changes is not experimentally identified.

title: Accenture: FY2025 financial performance
limitations: AI classifications are management-defined. Bookings are not recognized revenue or profit; company performance does not establish the whole market.

title: Thomson Reuters: 2025 full-year results
limitations: Growth includes more than AI. Organic and reported revenue growth are different metrics; no isolated causal AI profit measure.

title: Thomson Reuters: one million CoCounsel users
limitations: Reported users are not a disclosed paid-active-user cohort, retention measure or customer productivity estimate.

title: Salesforce: Q4 and FY2026 results
method: Company results and product ARR disclosures.
limitations: ARR is a run-rate metric, not period revenue. The combined Agentforce/Data 360 figure includes acquired Informatica Cloud ARR.

title: Intercom: pricing
limitations: List price per outcome is not the full customer cost. Eligibility, plan charges and negotiated terms can differ.

title: Intercom: pricing FAQs and outcome definition
limitations: A billed resolution can include a customer leaving without requesting more help; it is not independently verified customer success.

title: Google Cloud: 2025 DORA findings
method: Primary survey research summary; nearly 5,000 technology professionals.
limitations: Associations between AI use and delivery outcomes are not randomized causal estimates. Publisher supplies development tools.
